name: Synchro audio MadVision
description: Aligns the selected clips on a master clip by their sound with the local MadVision sync service (/sync/analyze on 127.0.0.1:8765: audio fingerprints and consensus), then moves them in one undo step. Master = the longest selected clip, or --var master=<clip id>. Clips the service cannot place, whose new place is taken, or not at 100 % speed stay put and are named. Reads the saved .fcproj: save first. Needs the MadVision service and its token (~/.madvision/config.json, never shown).
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Caler les clips sélectionnés sur le master
entries.description: Analyse, then move each clip the service syncs; a summary of offsets and the service's answer is written to sync-madvision-last.json in the data folder.

entries.label: Analyser la synchro sans rien déplacer
entries.description: Only reports each clip's offset on the master.
